credentialOverwrite.summary: Connected Cartrack settings kept an editable credential form with browser autofill enabled (autocomplete=username/current-password). Owner profile email could populate the username field while the API username hint correctly stayed masked. Submitting Update connection sent invalid credentials; failed validation set status=error without replacing encrypted credentials, but broke the connected UX and surfaced Cartrack rejected the provided credentials.
fixes: Hide credential form when connected; show read-only connection card
Disable autofill on credential fields (autocomplete=off / new-password)
Validate-before-save on replace; preserve stored credentials and connected status on failure
Owner-only replace flow with confirmation dialog
POST /integrations/cartrack/verify-stored to re-test encrypted credentials without browser secrets

autoMapGap.summary: Auto-mapping only ran during manual sync and used trim+lowercase only (no separator normalisation). CF172047 vs CF-172047 would not match. Initial background sync depended on SCHEDULERS_ENABLED gate and orchestrator hook — mapping did not run at connect when sync never fired.
fixes: Shared normalizeVehicleRegistration strips spaces/hyphens/separators before exact match
Ambiguous duplicate plates left for review instead of guessing
Auto-map audit entries for each automatic mapping
Connect hook triggers integration-sync-orchestrator initial Cartrack sync
UI groups mappings: Automatically matched vs Needs review categories
